home.seoTitle: Medical textile manufacturer in Delhi, India
home.seoBody:
Rank INC manufactures, supplies and exports medical textiles from Bawana Industrial Area, New Delhi. Hospitals, nursing homes, clinics, laboratories and distributors buy their reusable hospital apparel, O.T. and ward linen, disposable hospital apparel, surgical drapes, procedure packs and hospital mattresses from one source.

## Hospital apparel
Scrub suits in nine standard colours, women’s Elegance and Leisure scrub styles, lab coats, surgeon gowns and patient gowns. Departments can be colour-coded, and the hospital’s name or logo can be embroidered.

## O.T. and ward linen
Fitted and flat bed sheets, draw sheets, cut sheets, O.R. sheets, pillow covers and protectors, mattress protectors, underpads, blankets, bath towels and linen bags.

## Surgical drapes and procedure packs
Procedure-specific drapes for gynaecology, neurology, orthopaedic and cardiovascular surgery, and ready-to-use packs for general surgery, obstetrics & gynaecology, orthopaedics, cardiovascular and neurosurgery. Pack contents can be built around a hospital’s own protocol.

## Mattresses, disposables and warming
Mattresses for ICU, Fowler and semi-Fowler beds, pressure redistribution pads and pillows; disposable aprons, scrub sets, lab coats, coveralls and surgical, fluid-protection and isolation gowns; and patient warming blankets in adult and paediatric formats.

about.title: Medical textiles that hospitals can rely on
about.body:
Rank INC is a manufacturer, supplier and exporter of medical textile products. Our range covers reusable hospital apparel, O.T. and ward linen, disposable hospital apparel, drapes, sheets, procedure packs, and hospital mattresses, pads and accessories.

We are dedicated to delivering high-quality healthcare solutions that combine innovation, safety and compassion, so that patients get better outcomes and medical professionals get support they can trust.

Every product is checked by our inspection department before it leaves our unit in Bawana Industrial Area, New Delhi. We also make customised products to match each client’s requirements, and we supply both domestic and international markets.
about.mission: To provide reliable, hygienic and innovative hospital apparel and disposable solutions.
about.vision: To lead in quality medical textiles, enhancing safety and comfort in healthcare.

legal.privacy:
This policy explains what information this website collects and how Rank INC uses it.

What we collect. When you send a quote basket or an enquiry, we receive the details you type in: your name, organisation, mobile number, email address, GSTIN, delivery address, the products you chose and any notes. We also keep basic technical records such as the time of the request and your browser type, to protect the site from misuse.

How we use it. We use these details only to prepare quotes, confirm and deliver orders, raise invoices and reply to your enquiry, including by phone, WhatsApp or email.

What stays in your browser. Your basket, saved products and form details are stored in your own browser so you do not have to type them again. You can clear them at any time by clearing your browser’s site data.

Sharing. We do not sell your information. We share it only with the people needed to fulfil your order, such as transporters, or when the law requires it.

Contact. To see, correct or delete the information we hold about you, contact us using the details on the Contact page.
legal.terms:
These terms apply to quote requests and orders placed through this website.

Quotes and prices. Sending a quote basket is a request, not a confirmed order. Prices shown on the website exclude GST unless stated. Items marked “Price on request” are priced by our team. An order is confirmed only when we confirm the price, quantity, freight and dispatch date with you.

Products and customisation. Product photos and illustrations are for reference; shades can vary slightly between batches and screens. Customised products are made to the specification agreed in writing.

Payment. Payment terms are agreed with each order. Credit terms apply only to approved institutional accounts.

Delivery. Dispatch dates are confirmed with your order. Freight is charged as confirmed in the quote.

Quality concerns. Please inspect goods on delivery and tell us about any shortage or damage as soon as possible, with photos, so we can resolve it.

Contact. For any question about these terms, contact us using the details on the Contact page.

faq.q: What types of hospital products do you manufacture and supply?
faq.a: We manufacture, supply and export a broad range of hospital products: reusable and disposable apparel, O.T. and ward linen, drapes, sheets, procedure packs, and hospital mattresses, pads and accessories.

faq.q: Do you provide customized hospital products?
faq.a: Yes. We offer customised solutions to match your requirements, from colours and sizes to logo embroidery and procedure-pack contents, designed around the practical needs of healthcare professionals.

faq.q: Are your products suitable for both domestic and international markets?
faq.a: Yes. We serve hospitals and distributors in India and abroad, with quality standards that meet global healthcare requirements.

faq.q: How do I get prices for a bulk order?
faq.a: Add the products you need to your quote basket with sizes and quantities, then send it. Your request is saved with us and opens in WhatsApp, and our team replies with prices, freight and dispatch dates.

faq.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
faq.a: Pick your preferred method when you send the basket: bank transfer (NEFT/RTGS), UPI, credit terms or cash on delivery. The team confirms payment terms along with your quote.
